svg.title: Shipyard architecture
svg.desc: People talk to agents in chat rooms through Switch. Agents can only ask the Gatekeeper, which checks roles, asks for approvals and the SBOM gate, writes the audit log and then calls Coolify, Kubernetes, GitHub and the ops VM with least-privilege credentials.

g.text: People: Discord · Slack · Mattermost
owner · maintainer · deployer · viewer, identified by the platform account Switch reports for each message
Layer 1: Switch
Rooms bridged to chat · agent protocol · addressing policy: only project members may talk to an agent, only in the project's rooms
The dashboard's "Agent access" page writes that policy from the roles.
Ops Agent · Repo Agent
Codex, on an unprivileged Linux user
Hold only the Gatekeeper's request tool
and a read-only, Secret-blind cluster view.
No Coolify, GitHub or Switch credential.
Layer 2: Gatekeeper (a custom Switch agent)
· roles per project; tiers read / change / dangerous / blocked
· approvals in chat: single use, bound to the exact action,
10 minutes, requester cannot approve their own
· SBOM gate: a new critical CVE, no SBOM or an unverified
one blocks a deploy; only an owner can override
· hash-chained audit log (SQLite) · fails closed
Alerts in (Coolify webhook) · PR and CI polling (GitHub App)
Dashboard
audit · approvals · SBOM
backends · roles · agents
loopback only, SSH tunnel;
cannot approve anything
Layer 3: backends, each with its own least-privilege credential
Coolify (deploy, rollback) · Kubernetes (viewer / deployer / ops service accounts) · GitHub App (merge pinned to a commit) · ops VM (forced-command SSH)
